rationale: I read the complete held EO 11532 (35 FR 8629, June 2, 1970), which establishes the Interdepartmental Committee for the Voluntary Payroll Savings Plan for U.S. Savings Bonds (secs. 1-3 committee, functions and agency duties), defines 'Federal agencies' and in sec. 4 supersedes EO 10626; it has no own sunset and no savings clause. I read the complete held EO 11981 (42 FR 17009 range, March 29, 1977), which re-establishes the successor Interagency Committee for the Purchase of U.S. Savings Bonds in sec. 1 and states in sec. 5 'This Order supersedes Executive Order No. 11532 of June 2, 1970.' The sentence names the whole order with no section, subject or time limitation and there is no savings clause in EO 11981; the successor committee (with the added Military Bond Allotment Plan) takes over the same functions, so no part of EO 11532 is left as an independent command. The catalog note ('Superseded by: EO 11981, March 29, 1977'), its two candidate events, and the 1989 Codification row ('Superseded by EO 11981') agree, but they are editorial leads; the basis is the held acting text, and the March 29, 1977 signing date is not asserted as an effective date. Earlier endings: I found no earlier ending instrument in the held record and the history lists none; the unexamined possibility is not material to a NO as of 2026-10-14. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
